headline: Cyberattack disabled refrigeration at hundreds of French supermarkets, spoiling food
summary: A cyberattack remotely defrosted refrigeration systems at hundreds of French supermarkets by targeting Danfoss controllers running outdated firmware, according to the manufacturer. Temperatures soared to 50C overnight, spoiling stock; one store reported fridge temperatures reaching 27C (80F) and a total loss of fresh and frozen food.
